chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If you become forgetful concerning the first two rakʿahs, then repeat them until you establish them with certainty.

key_terms.الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ: the first two rakʿahs of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one forgets or doubts the first two rakʿahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt or forgetfulness in the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer). It indicates that when certainty about the first two rakʿahs is lost, they must be repeated until they are firmly established.
